title: Virtual Screening Expands the Non-Natural Amino Acid Palette for Peptide Optimization.
authors: Amarasinghe, Kosala N; De Maria, Leonardo; Tyrchan, Christian; Eriksson, Leif A; Sadowski, Jens; Petrovic, Dusan
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文构建非天然氨基酸虚拟库并通过对接筛选优化肽段，虽涉及蛋白-肽互作建模，但对象为Keap1-Neh2肽段而非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或MD方法，仅对接筛选，与课题关联度较低。
abstract: Peptides are an important modality in drug discovery. While current peptide optimization focuses predominantly on the small number of natural and commercially available non-natural amino acids, the chemical spaces available for small molecule drug discovery are in the billions of molecules. In the present study, we describe the development of a large virtual library of readily synthesizable non-natural amino acids that can power the virtual screening protocols and aid in peptide optimization. To that end, we enumerated nearly 380 thousand amino acids and demonstrated their vast chemical diversity compared to the 20 natural and commercial residues. Furthermore, we selected a diverse ten thousand amino acid subset to validate our virtual screening workflow on the Keap1-Neh2 complex model system. Through in silico mutations of Neh2 peptide residues to those from the virtual library, our docking-based protocol identified a number of possible solutions with a significantly higher predicted affinity toward the Keap1 protein. This protocol demonstrates that the non-natural amino acid chemical space can be massively extended and virtually screened with a reasonable computational cost.
abstract_zh: 肽类药物发现中，肽是一种重要的模式。当前的肽优化主要集中于少数天然及商业可得的非天然氨基酸，而小分子药物发现可用的化学空间则拥有数十亿分子。在本研究中，我们描述了一个大型虚拟库的开发，该库包含易于合成的非天然氨基酸，可支持虚拟筛选方案并辅助肽优化。为此，我们枚举了近38万种氨基酸，并展示了它们与20种天然及商业残基相比的巨大化学多样性。此外，我们选取了一个包含一万种氨基酸的多样性子集，以在Keap1-Neh2复合物模型系统上验证我们的虚拟筛选工作流程。通过将Neh2肽残基进行计算机模拟突变，替换为虚拟库中的残基，我们基于对接的方案识别出多个可能的解决方案，这些方案对Keap1蛋白的预测亲和力显著提高。该方案表明，非天然氨基酸化学空间可以大幅扩展，并以合理的计算成本进行虚拟筛选。
